{"id":"6ce18808-a766-40a7-9e65-3cb5a66d3e89","object":"chat.completion","created":1790510235,"model":"deepseek-flash","choices":[{"index":0,"message":{"role":"assistant","content":"{"parent_requirement_id": "R2", "mode": "probe", "used_claims": [], "local_residual": "Establish the foundational-gift event in which the person and their spouse acted as donors for the construction of a building that was part of a larger complex, including identifying the building and larger complex if their referents are not yet established."}","reasoning_content":"We need answer JSON only. We need derive one local research residual inside parent requirement R2. No supporting claims. Mode probe used_claims []. Need local_residual: one exploratory evidence objective, not search query. Need identify coherent evidence objective inside R2. Parent requirement: "This person and their spouse, who, up to 2019, had no children from the marriage, made a foundational gift for the construction of a building that was part of a larger complex." No supporting claims. Need choose one facet. Since unsupported, probe mode. We need not solve whole. Could target establishing the foundational gift by the person and spouse for construction of a building part of a larger complex. Or maybe unknown entity "building" relation. We need preserve roles. Since no claims, can choose exploratory evidence objective: identify the building (and larger complex) for which the person and their spouse made a foundational gift for its construction, with their spousal relationship and no children up to 2019? But that bundles spouse condition? Need exactly one coherent part. The parent has multiple conditions: person and spouse made foundational gift; spouse had no children from marriage up to 2019; building part of larger complex. We need one coherent evidence objective. Since prior unsupported, maybe choose the foundational gift relation as core. But we shouldn't bundle "person and spouse" maybe that's a participant pair. We can formulate: "Establish whether the person and their spouse made a foundational gift for the construction of a building that was part of a larger complex." That's essentially whole parent, but it's one relation. However instruction says if several independent unresolved parts, choose exactly one. The no children condition is separate. The building part of larger complex is attribute. But if no part supported, we can choose one facet. I'd choose the foundational gift event: that the person (along with spouse) made a foundational gift for construction of a building. That is coherent central relation. We can leave spouse no children and larger complex for later. But the parent requirement includes spouse as co-donor. So local_residual should mention person and spouse as donors. Also "foundational gift for construction of a building" objective. It doesn't require children condition. But maybe if we ignore "spouse, who up to 2019 had no children", we might lose participant roles? The spouse is co-donor, so included. The no-children is a relative clause about spouse, not central to gift? Could be separate condition. We can choose the gift relation. Alternatively choose "identify the building that was part of a larger complex and for which the person and spouse made a foundational gift." But building unknown. The central unresolved entity could be the building. The question downstream asks which university this building was part of. R2 is about gift and building. If no claims, the residual could be establishing the existence/identity of a building that was part of a larger complex and received a foundational gift from the person and spouse. That's coherent. But that's essentially whole R2 except no-children clause. I think that's acceptable as one coherent evidence objective: establish the foundational gift relation and target building. However instruction "Do not jump to downstream attribute whose referent still needs to be established." The building referent is not established; asking which university it part of would be downstream, but R2 asks building part of larger complex and gift. So okay.

Need JSON: parent_requirement_id "R2", mode "probe", used_claims [], local_residual "...". Ensure no search query. Could be: "Whether the person and their spouse made a foundational gift for the construction of a building, and if so, identify that building as part of a larger complex." That's one objective? It includes identify building. But maybe okay. But should we include no children? Since no claims, maybe we shouldn't ignore it entirely? Actually parent requirement has "spouse, who, up to 2019, had no children from the marriage" as condition. The local residual should be one coherent part. If we choose gift relation, we can mention spouse as participant, but not no-children. The no-children condition remains unaddressed. That's fine.

We need "used_claims": [] because no substantive supporting claim. mode probe.

Let's craft concise. "Establish the foundational-gift event in which the person and their spouse (as donors) gave a foundational gift for the construction of a building that was part of a larger complex, including identifying the building/larger complex if no referent is yet established." This is one coherent objective. But it mentions identifying building. Is that bundling? It's part of the relation object. The parent has object building. To establish gift relation, need object. That's okay.

Could also phrase: "Determine whether the person and their spouse made a foundational gift for the construction of a building, and establish the identity of that building as a component of a larger complex." That's one relation.

Need no search query.
